newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suspected separatists bomb Corsican savings bank.
newsitem.headline: Suspected separatists bomb Corsican savings bank.

text.p: A bomb exploded at a savings bank in eastern Corsica on Tuesday and police defused a second device planted by suspected separatists on the troubled French Mediterranean island.

No one was hurt when the bomb, linked to a gas canister, exploded at about 1.20 a.m. (0020 GMT) outside a savings bank in Ghisonaccia, smashing windows and damaging the facade and furniture inside, para-military gendarmes said.

They said a similar device was found half an hour later outside a branch of the Credit Agricole Mutuel de la Corse bank in the town. The detonator had failed to work and bomb disposal experts safely defused the device.
No one immediately claimed responsibility for either bomb.
Separatists have made thousands of similar attacks over the past two decades in a low-level campaign for more autonomy from mainland France.
